text.p: NTN Communications Inc said Tuesday that Patrick Downs resigned as chairman and chief executive and Daniel Downs stepped down as president.
The company said both will stay on the board.
The company said board member Ed Frazier has been named acting chairman, and Gerald Sokol, the company's chief financial officer, has been named company president.
Patrick Downs said he and his brother Daniel Downs stepped down because it is time for the co-founders of the company to leave its day to day management to others.
NTN said it approved contract settlement agreements reached with the Downs brothers and several other senior management personnel.
The company said substantial reserves for the settlements have been established and will be reflected along with other significant reserves in the company's 1996 fourth quarter results.
